question: In the rendered artifact bytes, does every drawn participant-name token sit in a blank this family listed as one the name belongs in?
method: Every flattened appearance in each fixture is read and matched back to the censused blank at its own measured rectangle. This is wider than the charge-caption question.
allowlistIsEmptyBecause: No blank on JD-CR-202 may carry the participant's name in this build. The caption name box binds a date of birth through the run-on header caption and is refused; the crimes box binds the name and is refused; the two print-name boxes are jurat fields and are refused. So any name token drawn at any rectangle in either fixture is a blocking finding, which is the strongest form this assertion can take.
